column1: # AQL Language Specification: the aql:rand module
# Loadable module of pseudo-random generators. Import binds the `Rand`
# namespace: `import "aql:rand"  Rand.word args`. A seeded generator
# (`Rand.with-seed n`) is a reproducible instance; the top-level words
# draw from a default generator seeded from the Clock capability — which
# this spec suite FREEZES (2021-01-01T00:00:00Z), so even the default
# draws are deterministic here. (See lang/spec/temporal.tsv for the clock.)
# §1  seeded generators are reproducible — same seed, same sequence
# §2  default generator — seeded from the (frozen, in specs) clock

column3: default draw is deterministic under the fixed clock
